cluster_summary: This cluster comprises 40 XWiki vulnerabilities, primarily server-side template injection (SSTI) and cross-site scripting (XSS), caused by user-controlled data being interpolated into templates without proper context-specific escaping (HTML, wiki syntax, or URL). Variants include incomplete delimiter escaping, bypassing the rendering pipeline, misconfigured output directives, unsafe wrapper removal, direct code evaluation, and one unrelated error-handling issue.
guideline_text: Trace lower-privilege script, template, macro, plugin, or API callers that can invoke privileged server-side capabilities into server-side include, template rendering, servlet dispatch, raw object access, internal file reads, or privileged framework APIs. Report code paths where a higher privilege check is not enforced at the API entry point before exposing the server-side capability. Confirm that the guard is enforced before the sensitive effect and remains bound to the same resource, principal, destination, or object that the effect uses. Treat this as a reusable mechanism-level pattern derived from 4 historical CVE example(s), not as a project-specific signature. A safe implementation should check the required higher privilege at the exposed API boundary and return no sensitive result when the caller lacks that privilege.

mechanism.missing_guard: a higher privilege check is not enforced at the API entry point before exposing the server-side capability
mechanism.name: privileged server-side capability exposed to lower privilege context
mechanism.sink_shape: server-side include, template rendering, servlet dispatch, raw object access, internal file reads, or privileged framework APIs
mechanism.source_shape: lower-privilege script, template, macro, plugin, or API callers that can invoke privileged server-side capabilities
mechanism.typical_fix: check the required higher privilege at the exposed API boundary and return no sensitive result when the caller lacks that privilege

sub_patterns.fix_strategy: Apply escapetool.xml() or equivalent HTML/XML escaping function to all dynamic values before embedding in HTML.
sub_patterns.name: Missing HTML/XML escaping in template output
sub_patterns.root_cause: User-controlled values are interpolated into HTML attributes or text nodes without applying HTML entity encoding, allowing injection of arbitrary HTML/JavaScript.

sub_patterns.fix_strategy: Use $services.rendering.escape(value, 'xwiki/2.1') to escape the value for the wiki syntax context before interpolation.
sub_patterns.name: Missing wiki syntax escaping in template output
sub_patterns.root_cause: User-controlled values are interpolated into XWiki wiki syntax markup without escaping special characters that denote macros or directives, enabling server-side template injection.

sub_patterns.fix_strategy: Set Content-Type to text/plain for non-HTML output; remove form-related tags from sanitizer allowlist.
sub_patterns.name: Missing Content-Type header or improper sanitizer allowlist
sub_patterns.root_cause: Non-HTML output is served with default text/html Content-Type, or the HTML sanitizer allows form tags that enable Groovy injection.

sub_patterns.fix_strategy: Use a helper that unwraps and applies HTML escaping.
sub_patterns.name: Unsafe stripping of safe HTML wrapper
sub_patterns.root_cause: Code removes the {{html}} wrapper that provides escaping, then outputs the unwrapped content without re-escaping.
